lines.py: Xiǎo yǔ shuō: “yīn wèi wǒ zài huí lái de lù shàng xiǎng míng bai le yí jiàn shì. zhè liǎng gè yuè, nǐ yě tiān tiān zhàn dào nà tái chèng shàng, nǐ de shù zì yì zhí méi biàn, duì bú duì?”
lines.en: Xiaoyu says, "Because on the way home, something dawned on me. These two months, you've stood on those scales every day too, and your number hasn't changed at all, has it?"

lines.text: 王明点点头，接着就反应过来了：秤被他调轻了两公斤，他的数字却一点儿没变，也就是说，他自己胖了两公斤。
lines.py: Wáng Míng diǎn diǎn tóu, jiē zhe jiù fǎn yìng guò lái le: chèng bèi tā diào qīng le liǎng gōng jīn, tā de shù zì què yì diǎn r méi biàn, yě jiù shì shuō, tā zì jǐ pàng le liǎng gōng jīn.
lines.en: Wang Ming nods, and then it hits him: he set the scales two kilos light, yet his own number hasn't moved. In other words, he's put on two kilos himself.

lines.py: tā kàn le kàn chá jī shàng nà yí dà duī kōng líng shí dài—— dōu shì Xiǎo yǔ bù chī le, tā tì tā chī diào de.
lines.en: He looks at the big pile of empty snack bags on the coffee table: all the snacks Xiaoyu gave up, which he ate for her.

lines.text: 小雨笑着把跑鞋递给他：“明天晚上，五公里，你跟我一起跑。”
lines.py: Xiǎo yǔ xiào zhe bǎ pǎo xié dì gěi tā: “míng tiān wǎn shang, wǔ gōng lǐ, nǐ gēn wǒ yì qǐ pǎo.”
lines.en: Xiaoyu laughs and hands him his running shoes. "Tomorrow evening, five kilometres. You're running with me."
